<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001353" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_806_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock_zfj2brDComu" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>3.
<span id="xdx_822_zT7H3whEfOl">BUSINESS COMBINATIONS</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">ENVOY
TECHNOLOGIES, INC.</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
April 18, 2023, the Company, Blink Mobility, LLC, a California limited liability company and wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;Mobility&#8221;),
and Mobility Merger Sub Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly-owned subsidiary of Mobility (&#8220;Merger Sub&#8221;), entered into
and, after all parties met the closing conditions, consummated the transactions contemplated under an Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated
as of April 18, 2023 (the &#8220;Acquisition Agreement&#8221;), with Envoy Technologies, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;Envoy&#8221;).
Pursuant to the Acquisition Agreement, Merger Sub merged with and into Envoy, whereupon the separate corporate existence of Merger Sub
ceased, and Envoy was the surviving corporation of the merger and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mobility (the &#8220;Acquisition&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
the terms of the Acquisition Agreement, the acquisition consideration was up to $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_pn3n3_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember_zGXMijxxPQdk" title="Purchase price of business combination"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember" id="Fact001355" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">35,500</ix:nonFraction></span>, paid as follows: (i) $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross_pn3n3_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember_zxuLyWdT513" title="Cash paid"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember" id="Fact001357" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">6,000</ix:nonFraction></span> in cash paid upon
the closing of the Acquisition Agreement (the &#8220;Closing&#8221;); (ii) a promissory note of Mobility in the principal amount of $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_pn3n3_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--PromissoryNoteDueTwelveMonthsMember_z0Nev913D71" title="Principal amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember_custom_PromissoryNoteDueTwelveMonthsMember" id="Fact001359" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">5,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
which bears interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--PromissoryNoteDueTwelveMonthsMember_zTN7lymcJDU1" title="Interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember_custom_PromissoryNoteDueTwelveMonthsMember" id="Fact001361" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum and becomes due 12 months from Closing; (iii) a promissory note of Mobility in the principal
amount of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_pn3n3_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--PromissoryNoteDueEighteenMonthsMember_zNZJIcWU9O7f" title="Principal amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember_custom_PromissoryNoteDueEighteenMonthsMember" id="Fact001363" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">2,000</ix:nonFraction></span> which bears interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--PromissoryNoteDueEighteenMonthsMember_zAVruPwBnioi" title="Interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember_custom_PromissoryNoteDueEighteenMonthsMember" id="Fact001365" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum and becomes due 18 months from Closing; and (iv)<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--BusinessAcquisitionAgreementDescription_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--AcquisitionAgreementMember_zoX3HVuQiyOg" title="Business acquisition agreement description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_AcquisitionAgreementMember" id="Fact001367" name="BLNK:BusinessAcquisitionAgreementDescription">(a) in the event of an
initial public offering or direct listing of Mobility or Mobility&#8217;s successor within 24 months after the Closing (and shares of
common stock of the Company are not issued in lieu thereof), $18,500, $21,000 or $22,500 worth of shares of common stock of Mobility
or Mobility&#8217;s successor, depending on the timing of such offering or listing, (b) in the event there is no initial public offering
or direct listing of Mobility or Mobility&#8217;s successor within 24 months after the Closing, $21,000 worth of shares of common stock
of the Company, or (c) at the Company&#8217;s option, a combination of cash and common stock of the Company with an aggregate value of
$21,000.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
aggregate purchase price was $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_pn3n3_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_z6vpnKoVpGWi" title="Purchase price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember" id="Fact001369" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">30,900</ix:nonFraction></span>, which included working capital deficit of $<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--WorkingCapitalDeficit_iI_pn3n3_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_zFQ9k9IChU3b" title="Working capital deficit"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:WorkingCapitalDeficit" contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember" id="Fact001371" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,595</ix:nonFraction></span> and closing date cash of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable_pn3n3_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_zvFcd36wmric" title="Cash"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember" id="Fact001373" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">19</ix:nonFraction></span>. <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsDescription_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_zciULUKalAOa" title="Business combination, contingent consideration arrangements, description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember" id="Fact001375" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsDescription">The fair value of
the consideration paid in the acquisition consisted of: (a) $6,000 in cash ($4,679 was paid at Closing and $1,321 was paid prior to Closing
in the form of a note receivable); (b) $6,782 in aggregate promissory notes; and (c) $18,118 in common stock of Mobility subject to the
conditions described above.</ix:nonNumeric></span> The payment of shares of common stock of Mobility or Mobility&#8217;s successor, if any, will be based on
the public offering price per share of such stock in the initial public offering. The payment of shares of common stock of the Company,
if any, will be based on the average of the daily-weighted average prices for such stock on each of the 60 days ending on the day prior
to issuance thereof. The common stock consideration payable in the amount of $<span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationPayable_iI_pn3n3_c20231231_zmWs7fXFDrQg" title="Consideration payable"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationPayable" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31" id="Fact001377" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">18,118</ix:nonFraction></span> is included within consideration payable on the
consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2023.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company engaged a third-party independent valuation specialist to assist in the determination of fair values of tangible and intangible
assets acquired and liabilities assumed for Envoy. The final determination of the fair value of assets and liabilities will be completed
within the one-year measurement period as required by ASC 805. The Company recognized certain measurement period adjustments, as summarized
in the fair values of assets acquired and liabilities assumed in the tables below. Measurement period adjustments are recognized in the
reporting period in which the adjustments are determined and calculated as if the accounting had been completed at the acquisition date.
The acquisition will necessitate the use of this measurement period to adequately analyze and assess the factors used in establishing
the asset and liability fair values as of the relevant acquisition date, including intangible assets, accounts receivable and certain
fixed assets.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A9_zXTrjCqCj1Jc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the acquisition of Envoy, the Company acquired intangible assets in the form of a trade name, customer relationships,
internally developed technology and non-compete agreements. The Company used the relief from royalty method when determining the fair
value of the acquired trade name and internally developed technology. The fair value was determined by applying an estimated royalty
rate to revenues, measuring the value the Company would pay in royalties to a market participant if it did not own the trade name and
internally developed technology and had to license it from a third party. The trademark was assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--TrademarksMember_zTuNKrXCSwt5" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_us-gaap_TrademarksMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001414" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">2</ix:nonNumeric></span> years and the
internally developed technology was assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--DevelopedTechnologyRightsMember_ze1QkvEMI4sl" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_us-gaap_DevelopedTechnologyRightsMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001416" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">3</ix:nonNumeric></span> years.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">When
determining fair value of customer relationships, a form of income approach, known as the multi period excess earnings method was used.
The fair value was determined by calculating the present value of estimated future operating cash flows generated from the existing customers
less costs to realize the revenue. The Company applied a discount rate of <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember_z1z0dj7NsRGc" title="Percentage of discount"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember" id="Fact001418" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">21</ix:nonFraction></span>%, which reflected the nature of the assets as they relate
to the risk and uncertainty of the estimated future operating cash flows. Other significant assumptions used to estimate the fair value
of the customer contracts include an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember_zvRbp53ZwRv8" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember" id="Fact001420" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The customer relationships were assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember_zZl9gBrVuqwg" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001422" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">5.3</ix:nonNumeric></span> years.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used a discounted cash flow model when determining the fair value of the non-compete agreements. Significant assumptions included
a discount rate of <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember_zlgZwEtjTRC9" title="Percentage of discount"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember" id="Fact001424" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">21</ix:nonFraction></span>% and an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20230417__20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember_zm1PZ5x37lqg" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2023-04-172023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember" id="Fact001426" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The non-compete agreements were assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20230418__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember_zpbcc9Yoo1y7" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2023-04-18_custom_EnvoyTechnologiesIncMember_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001428" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">2</ix:nonNumeric></span> years.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of working capital accounts was determined to be the carrying values due to the short-term nature of the assets and liabilities.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of property and equipment was estimated by applying the cost approach. The cost approach uses the replacement or reproduction
cost as an indicator of fair value. The assumptions of the cost approach include replacement cost new, projected capital expenditures,
and physical deterioration factors including economic useful life, remaining useful life, age, and effective age.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the estimated fair value of the common stock consideration payable was $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--ContingentConsiderationClassifiedAsEquityFairValueDisclosure_iI_pn3n3_c20241231_zdcwKI5RjX97" title="Fair value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ContingentConsiderationClassifiedAsEquityFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001430" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">21,028</ix:nonFraction></span> and $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ContingentConsiderationClassifiedAsEquityFairValueDisclosure_iI_pn3n3_c20231231_zWlElBV3Dr01" title="Fair value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ContingentConsiderationClassifiedAsEquityFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31" id="Fact001432" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">18,118</ix:nonFraction></span>, respectively.
The Company uses a probability-weighted discounted cash flow approach as a valuation technique to determine the fair value of the
common stock consideration payable on the acquisition date and at each reporting period. The significant unobservable inputs used in
the fair value measurements are the probability outcome percentages that are assigned to each scenario. Significant increases or
decreases to either of these inputs in isolation could result in a significantly higher or lower liability with a higher liability
capped by the contractual maximum of the common stock consideration liability.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>3.
BUSINESS COMBINATIONS &#8211; CONTINUED</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">SEMACONNECT,
INC.</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
June 15, 2022, the Company completed the acquisition of SemaConnect, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;SemaConnect&#8221;) pursuant
to an Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of June 13, 2022 (&#8220;Acquisition Agreement&#8221;), by and among the Company, Blink
Sub I Corp., Blink Sub II LLC, SemaConnect and Shareholder Representative Services LLC (solely in its capacity as the stockholders&#8217;
representative). Following the closing of the acquisition, SemaConnect became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. SemaConnect is
a leading provider of EV charging infrastructure solutions in North America.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
aggregate purchase price was $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_pn3n3_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_z5kThiVCSc1g" title="Purchase price of business combination"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001472" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">200,573</ix:nonFraction></span>, which included excess working capital of $<span id="xdx_905_ecustom--WorkingCapital_iI_pn3n3_c20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zLefa9xX7wEe" title="Working Capital"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:WorkingCapital" contextRef="AsOf2022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001474" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,229</ix:nonFraction></span> and closing date cash of $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable_pn3n3_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zLcg2zOyViA4" title="Business combination equity interests issued and issuable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001476" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">3,639</ix:nonFraction></span>. <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsDescription_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zR8O89UtNdG3" title="Business combination, description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001478" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsDescription">The consideration
paid in the acquisition consisted of: (a) $86,736 in cash, (i) of which $46,136 was paid at the closing of the Acquisition Agreement
(&#8220;Closing&#8221;) and (ii) the remaining $40,600 is payable (bearing interest at 7%) until not earlier than nine months following
the Closing and not later than three years following the Closing; and (b) 7,454,975 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock with a
fair value of $113,837.</ix:nonNumeric></span> Included in the cash consideration was $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiability_iI_pn3n3_c20231231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_ziHzrq0apHcc" title="Cash consideration"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiability" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001480" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">8,103</ix:nonFraction></span> related to payments due to stock option holders of SemaConnect.
Subsequent to the closing of the acquisition, payments to the stock option holder were made after the stock option holder signed an option
cash-out agreement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Goodwill
was recorded based on the amount by which the purchase price exceeded the fair value of the net assets acquired and the amount is attributable
to the reputation of the business acquired, the workforce in place and the synergies to be achieved from this acquisition. Goodwill of
$<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--Goodwill_iI_pn3n3_c20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zTpHBkSy0ela" title="Goodwill"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="AsOf2022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001482" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">174,439</ix:nonFraction></span> from the acquisition of SemaConnect is not expected to be deductible for income tax purposes.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>(in

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>3.
BUSINESS COMBINATIONS &#8211; CONTINUED</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">SEMACONNECT,
INC. - CONTINUED</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the acquisition of SemaConnect, the Company acquired tradename, customer relationships, internally developed technology
and non-compete agreements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used the relief from royalty method when determining the fair value of the acquired trademark and internally developed technology.
The fair value was determined by applying an estimated royalty rate to revenues, measuring the value the Company would pay in royalties
to a market participant if it did not own the trademark and internally developed technology and had to license it from a third party.
The trademark was assigned a useful life of two years and the internally developed technology was assigned a useful life of three years.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">When
determining fair value of customer relationships, a form of income approach, known as the multi period excess earnings method was used.
The fair value was determined by calculating the present value of estimated future operating cash flows generated from the existing customers
less costs to realize the revenue. The Company applied a discount rate of <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_dp_uPure_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zbHXVSkix9c6" title="Percentage of discount to customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001521" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">20</ix:nonFraction></span>%, which reflected the nature of the assets as they relate
to the risk and uncertainty of the estimated future operating cash flows. Other significant assumptions used to estimate the fair value
of the customer contracts include an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_dp_uPure_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zHzLlnxwKfRd" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate of customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001523" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The customer relationships were assigned a <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20220615__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zexFGwUc2L2h" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2022-06-15_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_SemaconnectMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001525" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">5</ix:nonNumeric></span>-year useful life.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used a discounted cash flow model when determining the fair value of the non-compete agreements, significant assumptions include
a discount rate of <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_dp_uPure_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zZxyaHv7lVgh" title="Percentage of discount to customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001527" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">20</ix:nonFraction></span>% and an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_dp_uPure_c20220615__20220615__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember_zfRAXa3v9jij" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate of customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2022-06-152022-06-15_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember_custom_SemaconnectMember" id="Fact001529" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The non-compete agreements were assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dc_c20220615__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--SemaconnectMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember_zbHuwc3kpYU" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2022-06-15_custom_SemaconnectMember_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001531" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">two years</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of working capital accounts was determined to be the carrying values due to the short-term nature of the assets and liabilities.

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>3.
BUSINESS COMBINATIONS &#8211; CONTINUED</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">ELECTRIC
BLUE LIMITED </span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
April 22, 2022, pursuant to a Sale and Purchase Agreement dated April 22, 2022, the Company acquired, through its Dutch subsidiary, Blink
Holdings B.V., all of the outstanding capital stock of Electric Blue Limited (&#8220;EB&#8221;), a private company limited by shares
and registered in England and Wales, from its shareholders. Headquartered in St. Albans, United Kingdom, EB is a leading provider of
electric vehicle charging and sustainable energy solutions and technologies. EB works with local authorities and businesses to create
the infrastructure the United Kingdom needs to meet the 2050 net zero emissions target and prepare for the 2030 ban on the sale of new
petrol and diesel cars and vans.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value purchase price for the acquisition of all of EB&#8217;s outstanding capital stock was $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_pn3n3_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zZKuehyVtgjk" title="Business combination, consideration transferred"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001573" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">19,317</ix:nonFraction></span>, consisting of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedCashAndEquivalents_iI_pn3n3_c20220422__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SaleandPurchaseAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zQeJ7tpq6sZg" title="Business combination,cash and equivalents"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedCashAndEquivalents" contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_custom_SaleandPurchaseAgreementMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001575" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">12,651</ix:nonFraction></span> in cash,
<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued_pid_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zZPBdTrK9TZh" title="Business acquisition, Number of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001577" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">152,803</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock with a fair value of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable_pn3n3_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zthnVAI7xbbk" title="Business combination,equity interests issued and issuable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001579" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">2,852</ix:nonFraction></span>, plus the contingent consideration described in the following
paragraph. The fair value of the common stock consideration was determined by the closing price of the Company&#8217;s common stock on
the acquisition date.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition, provided EB reaches specified gross revenue or new EV charger installation targets over the three years post-closing, the Company
also agreed to issue up to approximately $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues_pn3n3_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zeI6UMv2HMCc" title="Additional shares of common stock"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001581" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">6,400</ix:nonFraction></span> in additional shares of its common stock to EB shareholders (the &#8220;Contingent Consideration&#8221;).
The Contingent Consideration was recorded at an estimated fair value of $<span id="xdx_909_ecustom--BusinessCombinationContingentConsideration_iI_pn3n3_c20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zkLA5MQQkokc" title="Contingent consideration"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:BusinessCombinationContingentConsideration" contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001583" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">3,814</ix:nonFraction></span>. As of December 31, 2022, the estimated fair value of
the Contingent Consideration was $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityNoncurrent_iI_pn3n3_c20221231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zVrKB5hDFoqe" title="Contingent consideration"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityNoncurrent" contextRef="AsOf2022-12-31_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001585" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,316</ix:nonFraction></span>. The Company uses a probability-weighted discounted cash flow approach as a valuation technique
to determine the fair value of the contingent consideration liabilities on the acquisition date and at each reporting period. The significant
unobservable inputs used in the fair value measurements are projections over the earn-out period, and the probability outcome percentages
that are assigned to each scenario. Significant increases or decreases to either of these inputs in isolation could result in a significantly
higher or lower liability with a higher liability capped by the contractual maximum of the contingent consideration liabilities.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Of
the purchase price to be issued to the EB shareholders at closing, approximately $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedCashAndEquivalents_iI_pn3n3_c20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zz7miojxPMRk" title="Current assets, cash"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedCashAndEquivalents" contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact001587" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">650</ix:nonFraction></span> in cash and <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued_pid_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zcjhXMBl50Lh" title="Business acquisition, equity interest issued or issuable, number of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact001589" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">25,466</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock are being
held in escrow accounts for periods of 12 months (cash escrow) and 18 months (stock escrow), respectively, following the closing to cover
any losses or damages we may incur by reason of, among other things, any misrepresentation or breach of warranty by EB under the Sale
and Purchase Agreement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Goodwill
was recorded based on the amount by which the purchase price exceeded the fair value of the net assets acquired and the amount is attributable
to the reputation of the business acquired, the workforce in place and the synergies to be achieved from this acquisition. Goodwill of
$<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--Goodwill_iI_pn3n3_c20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zNKu08TlzVy5" title="Goodwill"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001591" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">10,443</ix:nonFraction></span> from the acquisition of EB is expected to be deductible for income tax purposes.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</div></ix:continuation></div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span id="xdx_C05_gL3SOBABATB-SGNS_zLwPn9XMhIVl"><ix:continuation id="ConU001596-03"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span>&#160;</span></span></ix:continuation></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used the relief from royalty method when determining the fair value of the acquired trademark and internally developed technology.
The fair value was determined by applying an estimated royalty rate to revenues, measuring the value the Company would pay in royalties
to a market participant if it did not own the trademark and internally developed technology and had to license it from a third party.
The trademark was assigned a useful life of one and half years and the internally developed technology was assigned a useful life of
one year.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">When
determining fair value of customer relationships, a form of income approach, known as the multi period excess earnings method was used.
The fair value was determined by calculating the present value of estimated future operating cash flows generated from the existing customers
less costs to realize the revenue. The Company applied a discount rate of <span id="xdx_900_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_dp_uPure_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zUXwHEoESqve" title="Percentage of discount to customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001644" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">23</ix:nonFraction></span>%, which reflected the nature of the assets as they relate
to the risk and uncertainty of the estimated future operating cash flows. Other significant assumptions used to estimate the fair value
of the customer contracts include an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_dp_uPure_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zEL8VFcZSZtk" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate of customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001646" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The assigned useful life for customer relationships was approximately
<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dc_c20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__us-gaap--CustomerRelationshipsMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zdQG1vokslN9" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_us-gaap_CustomerRelationshipsMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001648" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">six years</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used a discounted cash flow model when determining the fair value of the non-compete agreements, significant assumptions include
a discount rate of <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_dp_uPure_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zXYC8uRX96U4" title="Percentage of discount to customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001650" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">20</ix:nonFraction></span>% and an assumed income tax rate of <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate_dp_uPure_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zestnG7oROFi" title="Percentage of assumed income tax rate of customer relationships"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfAssumedIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001652" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The non-compete agreements were assigned a useful life of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dc_c20220422__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--NonCompeteAgreementMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_zbBXkh1hM0Bg" title="Intangible asset, useful life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2022-04-22_custom_NonCompeteAgreementMember_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001654" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife">two years</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company used a Monte-Carlo based simulation model when determining the fair value of the contingent consideration. The model takes into
account the Company&#8217;s projections as well as an assumed discount rate of <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--PercentageOfDiscountRate_dp_uPure_c20220422__20220422__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--ElectricBlueLimitedMember_z4ImYdUbEpX" title="Percentage of discount"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:PercentageOfDiscountRate" contextRef="From2022-04-222022-04-22_custom_ElectricBlueLimitedMember" id="Fact001656" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">12</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of working capital accounts was determined to be the carrying values due to the short-term nature of the assets and liabilities.
</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of property and equipment was estimated by applying the cost approach. The cost approach uses the replacement or reproduction
cost as an indicator of fair value. The assumptions of the cost approach include replacement cost new, projected capital expenditures,
and physical deterioration factors including economic useful life, remaining useful life, age, and effective age.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001973" name="us-gaap:GoodwillDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_801_eus-gaap--GoodwillDisclosureTextBlock_zpWIaomsnpX1" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>6.
<span id="xdx_826_zy00JkGodnq7">GOODWILL</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company considered the decline in its stock price to be an indicator of impairment
and, accordingly, performed a quantitative impairment assessment of its goodwill and intangible assets on the dates where such indicators
of impairment were identified in addition to performing its annual goodwill impairment analysis. This assessment involved comparing the
estimated fair value of each of its reporting units to the reporting unit&#8217;s carrying value, inclusive of the goodwill balance allocated
to the reporting unit.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Estimation
of the fair value of each reporting unit involved the projection of discounted future cash flows using certain assumptions that are subjective
in nature, including assumptions related to historical and market growth rates and gross margin improvements, as well as future operating
expense synergies and optimization, among other factors. Based on its analysis, the Company determined that the carrying value exceeded
the estimated fair value in all reporting units. Consequently, the Company recognized a goodwill impairment
charge of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--GoodwillImpairmentLoss_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231_zmBqbcZEOgVk" title="Goodwill impairment charge"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss" contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact001975" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">126,984</ix:nonFraction></span></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">and
$<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--GoodwillImpairmentLoss_pn3n3_c20230101__20231231_zDp0W5n1otNk" title="Goodwill impairment charge"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31" id="Fact001977" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">89,087</ix:nonFraction></span></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">in
the consolidated statements of operations during the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value measurements used in the evaluation described above are considered to be Level 3 valuations within the fair value
hierarchy, as the measurements involve projections of discounted future cash flows, which are derived from unobservable assumptions,
the most subjective of which are the discount rates for each respective reporting unit. The discount rate used for all reporting
units ranged from <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--GoodwillDiscountRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_znJKZskerjgi" title="Goodwill discount rate"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:GoodwillDiscountRate" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001979" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">20</ix:nonFraction></span></span><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">%

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact002114" name="us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80C_eus-gaap--DebtDisclosureTextBlock_zrlNFAg2KgV3" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>8.
<span id="xdx_826_zhz1YUK1TQr7">NOTES PAYABLE AND CONSIDERATION PAYABLE</span> </b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">SEMACONNECT-
NOTES PAYABLE</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Amendment
to Merger Agreement</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
August 4, 2023, the Company, SemaConnect LLC, its wholly-owned subsidiary, and Shareholder Representative Services LLC, on behalf of
the former stockholders of SemaConnect, Inc. (the &#8220;Stockholders&#8217; Representative&#8221;), entered into an amendment (the &#8220;Amendment&#8221;)
to the original Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of June 13, 2022 (the &#8220;Merger Agreement&#8221;), pursuant to which the Company
acquired SemaConnect.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
the terms of the Amendment, the parties modified the manner by which the &#8220;Deferred Merger Consideration&#8221; (which remains $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent_iI_pn3n3_c20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zWWqbsnxU2xi" title="Accrued interest"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent" contextRef="AsOf2023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002116" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">40,600</ix:nonFraction></span>,
plus accrued interest) will be paid by the Company. <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionDescriptionOfAcquiredEntity_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zBXUubJzh0ol" title="Business acquisition description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002118" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionDescriptionOfAcquiredEntity">As amended, the Company agreed to pay: (a) within 15 days following our consummation
of a financing transaction or series of related transactions in excess of $150,000 since the June 2022 closing of the Merger Agreement,
$12,500 of the outstanding Deferred Merger Consideration in cash to the former stockholders of SemaConnect (the &#8220;Stockholders&#8221;),
and (b) within 15 days following our consummation of any financing transaction or series of related transactions in excess of $250,000
since the closing of the Merger Agreement, fifty cents of every dollar of proceeds received by the Company in excess of $250,000 to repay
the Deferred Merger Consideration until all Deferred Merger Consideration is paid in full to the Stockholders.</ix:nonNumeric></span> The Company agreed that
its payment obligations will be guaranteed by all of the Company&#8217;s U.S. subsidiaries and secured by a security interest on all
assets of the Company and its United States subsidiaries. The Company also agreed that such obligations will be due and payable by April
1, 2025, shortening the original due date from June 13, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Each
Stockholder will have the right to convert its outstanding Deferred Merger Consideration (after the initial payment of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment_pn3n3_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zJC3ezCOd925" title="Initial payment"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment" contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002120" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">12,500</ix:nonFraction></span>, including
accrued interest) into shares of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--CommonStockConversionFeatures_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_z0OrSo4XU0q5"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002121" name="us-gaap:CommonStockConversionFeatures">the Company&#8217;s common stock at a conversion price equal to 126% of the seven-day average prior
to the date of the Amendment, provided that under no circumstance will the Company be obligated to issue such number of shares equal
to or in excess of 20% of the Company&#8217;s common stock to the Stockholders, taking into account all common stock previously issued
to such holders in the transaction. Under the Amendment, interest on the Deferred Merger Consideration was increased from 7% to 9.5%
per annum following the date of the Amendment until full repayment of Deferred Merger Consideration.</ix:nonNumeric></span> One half of the accrued interest
may be paid in cash and the other half may be paid in-kind.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
consideration of the agreement by the Stockholders to enter into the Amendment, the Company agreed to issue <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueCommonStockIssuedInConnectionWithExtinguishmentOfNotesPayable_pid_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_znY1bJLNn4Sd" title="Common stock issued in connection with extinguishment of notes payable"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueCommonStockIssuedInConnectionWithExtinguishmentOfNotesPayable" contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002123" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USD">158,372</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of its common
stock with a fair value of $<span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCommonStockIssuedInConnectionWithExtinguishmentOfNotesPayable_pn3n3_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zUix5Vs7betl" title="Common stock issued in connection with extinguishment of notes payable, value"><ix:nonFraction name="BLNK:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesCommonStockIssuedInConnectionWithExtinguishmentOfNotesPayable" contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002125" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="Shares">1,000</ix:nonFraction></span> (&#8220;Consent Fee&#8221;) (based on the average closing price on and over the three days before and
after the date of the Amendment) to the Stockholders&#8217; Representative. The Company also agreed to reimburse up to $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--LegalFees_pn3n3_c20230804__20230804__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zOhlSkaaGG48" title="Reimbursable legal fee"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LegalFees" contextRef="From2023-08-042023-08-04_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002127" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">50</ix:nonFraction></span> of the Stockholders&#8217;
Representative&#8217;s out-of-pocket expenses. The Amendment was determined to be an extinguishment of debt in accordance with ASC 470.
As a result, the Consent Fee of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt_pn3n3_c20230101__20231231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zAtCJ0k29Zk8" title="Loss on extinguishment of notes payable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002129" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,000</ix:nonFraction></span> was accounted for as a loss on extinguishment of notes payable on the consolidated statement of
operations during the year ended December 31, 2023. Furthermore, the Company will recognize up to $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LegalFees_pn3n3_c20230101__20231231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zsk9mY8UaPre" title="Reimbursable legal fee"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LegalFees" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002131" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">50</ix:nonFraction></span> of reimbursable legal fees as a
debt discount to the face of the note, which will be amortized through interest expense over the term of the note.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Repayment
</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company repaid the remaining principal balance of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--RepaymentsOfNotesPayable_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zaqfB5DIcD47" title="Repayments of notes payable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfNotesPayable" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002133" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">31,354</ix:nonFraction></span> due under this note as well as paid $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--InterestPayableCurrent_iI_pn3n3_c20241231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--DeferredMergerConsiderationMember_zLKkWvtv0y6h" title="Accrued interest"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InterestPayableCurrent" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_DeferredMergerConsiderationMember" id="Fact002135" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,139</ix:nonFraction></span>
of accrued interest. The amounts were previously included within consideration payable on the consolidated balance sheets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>8.
